title: The Jasmine Flowers
author: Toolika Rani
text:
Petals white, tender and pure
Bloomed in a bunch
On a Jasmine twig-
Fragrant, pleasing
Scenic!

A perfect sight,
Enviable bliss!

A calous hand
At the slender stem
Pulls and picks;
Pick, pick, pick!

The black skin
And palms turned white,
Full of corpses,
Catching the whiff
Of Jasmine;

Dead or alive?
